subject.title: fix(repair): stabilize prepared target runtime identity

question: Should the repair lane treat semantic index content and validated hidden flags as the complete checkout-identity boundary instead of requiring byte-for-byte equality of `.git/index`?
rationale: This is an intentional trust-boundary adjustment: the proposed behavior avoids false failures from Git stat-cache refreshes, but maintainers must decide whether the retained semantic fields are sufficient for the repair containment contract.

options.title: Validate the semantic boundary before merge
options.body: Confirm focused coverage for meaningful index-content and extension/flag mutations, then merge if the new comparison still rejects every unsafe checkout change.

options.title: Keep raw index-byte binding
options.body: Reject the change if byte-level index identity is required by the intended containment policy despite the false-positive setup failure.

recommendation.title: Validate the semantic boundary before merge
recommendation.body: Confirm focused coverage for meaningful index-content and extension/flag mutations, then merge if the new comparison still rejects every unsafe checkout change.
